# assimp_6927: submission package (generated by `leakproof package`; nothing has been posted)

Issue: https://github.com/assimp/assimp/issues/6927
Defect: heap-buffer-underflow in `glTF2::Buffer::Read` (`code/AssetLib/glTF2/glTF2Asset.inl:606`). Gate verdict: **verified**; evidence: verified.

**Partial fix.** Not fixed here: ParseDataURI still packs the data offset into a signed char (glTFCommon.cpp:88); the base64 branch of Buffer::Read, glTF2 image data URIs (glTF2Asset.inl:1192) and the glTF 1 importer (glTFAsset.inl:195, 513) still receive the wrapped pointer. This change only bounds-checks the raw-data copy that the PoC reaches.

## The patch

`0001-gltf2asset-fix-heap-buffer-underflow-in-gltf2-buffer.patch` (this directory), `git format-patch` form: apply with `git am 0001-gltf2asset-fix-heap-buffer-underflow-in-gltf2-buffer.patch`. The
author is `<your git identity>` unless `--author` was given; fix it with
`git commit --amend --reset-author`.

```diff
diff --git a/code/AssetLib/glTF2/glTF2Asset.inl b/code/AssetLib/glTF2/glTF2Asset.inl
--- a/code/AssetLib/glTF2/glTF2Asset.inl
+++ b/code/AssetLib/glTF2/glTF2Asset.inl
@@ -600,6 +600,11 @@
             if (statedLength != dataURI.dataLength) {
                 throw DeadlyImportError("GLTF: buffer \"", id, "\", expected ", ai_to_string(statedLength),
                         " bytes, but found ", ai_to_string(dataURI.dataLength));
+            }
+
+            // Bounds check: ensure dataURI.data points within the original URI string
+            if (dataURI.data == nullptr || dataURI.data < uri || dataURI.data + dataURI.dataLength > uri + it->GetStringLength()) {
+                throw DeadlyImportError("GLTF: buffer \"", id, "\" has invalid data URI");
             }
 
             this->mData.reset(new uint8_t[dataURI.dataLength], std::default_delete<uint8_t[]>());
```

## Planner's analysis (written before the fix; check it against the diff)

Nemotron 3 Ultra wrote this root-cause analysis before any patch existed. It can describe a
different mechanism than the one the final diff fixes, so it is here for the reviewer and never
in the commit message.

> In Buffer::Read, when processing a non-base64 data URI, the code copies dataURI.dataLength bytes from dataURI.data without verifying that this source range lies within the original URI string buffer. A malformed or incorrectly parsed data URI can cause dataURI.data to point outside the URI string, leading to a heap buffer underflow (or overflow) during memcpy.
